title: Irontech Evelyn Artist’s Muse 171cm S59 ROS MAX Silicone Companion Doll
descriptionHtml:
Long, loose waves and a Natural finish give Evelyn her sunlit studio look. Her 171cm D-cup silicone silhouette pairs with Irontech’s S59 ROS MAX head, included in the base build.

Make the Artist’s Muse your own with the Irontech hair, eye, skin and finish choices, then explore three editable configurations. Free standard US shipping is included in the displayed price.

editorialIntro.heading: A Space for Tomorrow
editorialIntro.paragraph: A vinyl record turns beside the studio window. Evelyn steps back from the canvas, then moves the coffee cup away from a spreading patch of afternoon light. Her visitor waits on the gray sofa, curious about the empty corner of the painting. She tests a little blue on the edge of her palette and sets the brush down. That corner can wait. There is still coffee in the pot, another record in its sleeve, and no reason to close the curtains yet.
